# TiniTrove

> Curated gifts, tech accessories, rare collectibles and self-care finds in Kenya.

TiniTrove is a Kenyan e-commerce platform specializing in curated and meaningful gifts. 
We offer nationwide delivery and secure payments via M-Pesa.
